about_the_game:
Game Type

The game type is an open world JRPG, currently under consideration, using the scenario and battle style of "OCTOPATH TRAVELER", coupled with the open world design of "The Witcher III", allowing players to leave the main line behind and explore the world freely, while combining the unranked design of "Object Spirit", requiring players to explore the world step by step, build equipment and gain skills to challenge higher intensity enemies, which is also an important element in advancing the plot This is also an important element to advance the plot. The combination of the three becomes a closed loop, which allows players to have a rich plot experience while also having fun exploring and avoiding the boring operation of a linear process.

Game setting

The story takes place in a magical overhead world, a world where there is a giant tree that can create life, and all objects that come into contact with life energy will become humanoid life, called "spirit of things". So in this world, there are various forms of human-like, such as animals: cats, dogs, snakes, rabbits, chickens, etc., and plants: flowers, trees, etc., and even non-living things: rocks, water drops, seats, books, and everything else you can think of. This way the world will become very interesting and anything can be added to the game to surprise the players. So this game has a Slime Lady, it's normal, right?
